components.text:
The Ritual of the Crusher takes ores and other crushable items from a linked chest and crushes them into their higher-value forms - for example, it will turn Coal into Blocks of Coal, Redstone Dust into Blocks of Redstone, etc. Tier 0, costs $(blood)5,000 LP$() to activate.
Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.

Various Demon Will types can be channeled into this ritual via the Aura to change its behavior - Corrosive Will grants effects similar to Silk Touch, Destructive Will similar to Fortune III, and Steadfast Will lets you choose between the two. Check the ritual's tooltip in-game (via the Ritual Diviner or a Divination Sigil) for the exact current bonuses on this branch.
